COBOL Developer (All Levels & Internal Paths Available)
Little Rock, AR
Apply

 

The Opportunity

Dillard’s is seeking passionate technical talent to join our Application Development team on-site at our corporate headquarters in Little Rock, Arkansas.  

Whether you are an experienced mainframe veteran ready to make an immediate impact, an entry-level computer science graduate who desires to learn COBOL, an experienced developer who is interesting in learning COBOL,  or an internal Dillard’s team member looking to launch a high-impact technical career, we have a seat for you. Our COBOL infrastructure powers the financial systems behind almost 300 stores nationwide. We don't just maintain the past; we build the efficient, high-scale foundation for Dillard's future. 

 

Pathways & Timelines

The Experienced Mainframe Expert : Bring your deep knowledge of enterprise systems to optimize, modernize, and architect high-volume data streams. You will mentor junior talent and solve complex architecture challenges starting as soon as you are hired.
The Entry-Level Innovator (January 2027 Start): You have a foundation in programming (Java, Python, C++, etc.) and a desire to learn the language that runs global commerce. You will join our structured Information Technology Training Program kicking off in January 2027.
The Internal Dillard’s Path (January 2027 Start): You already know our business, our culture, and our operations. If you have an analytical mindset and want to transition into corporate technology, we will train you through our Information Technology Training Program starting in January 2027.

 

What You’ll Do

Design and Develop: Write, test, and refine robust COBOL code to support critical financial applications.
Optimize Systems: Analyze existing mainframe processes to improve performance, reduce execution time, and ensure 24/7 reliability.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with database administrators, business analysts, and modern web/cloud teams to integrate mainframe data with modern digital platforms.
Problem Solve: Troubleshoot production anomalies, debug complex logic, and implement long-term structural solutions.

 

What We Look For

For Experienced Candidates:

Solid experience with COBOL, JCL, CICS, and DB2/VSAM or a willingness to learn a new language (COBOL).
Strong understanding of mainframe tools (e.g., TSO/ISPF, Changeman, or IBM Developer for z/OS).
Ability to research and document legacy code, debug issues, and modernize where needed.

For Entry-Level & Internal Candidates:

A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; OR equivalent analytical experience within Dillard's operations.
Basic understanding of relational databases (SQL) and core programming logic (loops, arrays, conditional statements).
Commitment to join and complete our comprehensive Information Technology Training Program beginning in January 2027 where we will teach you COBOL from the ground up.  (No prior experience with the language is necessary)

 

Why Choose Dillard’s in Little Rock?

True Career Stability: Mainframe engineering is the ultimate career insurance. At Dillard's, your work directly impacts a multi-billion dollar enterprise every single day.
Structured Training Pipeline: Our formal training program bridges the gap between raw analytical potential and enterprise systems engineering.
Mentorship Culture: Work side-by-side with seasoned industry experts who are genuinely invested in passing down their knowledge.
The Little Rock Advantage: Enjoy a high quality of life, short commutes, and an incredibly affordable cost of living in Arkansas' vibrant capital city.
Full Benefits Suite: Vacation, health/dental/vision insurance, 401(k) matching, and a generous employee discount at Dillard’s stores.

 

Ready to build the backbone of retail technology?

Experienced Applicants: Apply now for immediate consideration.
Entry-Level & Internal Applicants: Apply now to secure your spot in our January 2027 training class.
